description: Only invoices that have line items are averaged over.

c.request: Per invoice, what is the average of the invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items on an invoice? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded. Only invoices that have line items are averaged over.
c.sql:
SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice
FROM (
    SELECT invoice_number,
           AVG(product_price) AS invoice_mean_product_price,
           COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
) AS invoice_stats
WHERE invoice_mean_product_price IS NOT NULL;

d.request: For invoices with at least one line item, return the average across invoices of each invoice’s mean non-missing line-item product price, and the average number of line items per invoice, as a single row with unrounded values.
d.sql:
SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice
FROM (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(product_price) AS invoice_mean_product_price,
         COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
) AS invoice_stats;

b.request: Average the per-invoice mean `product_price` across invoices with at least one line item and a non-missing `product_price`, and average the number of line items per invoice across invoices with at least one line item; return both unrounded averages in a single row.
b.sql:
WITH invoice_stats AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(product_price) AS mean_product_price,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
    AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_per_invoice_mean_product_price,
    AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice
FROM invoice_stats
